title: Solution Engineer - Substation Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Substation Automation Engineer**  
  
**Job Description**:

We are seeking a senior Substation Automation Engineer with 12+ years of experience in engineering, integrating, testing, and implementing automation and control systems for electrical substations. The role covers HMI/SCADA engineering, RTU and gateway integration, IEC 61850 communication design, network architecture, cyber security, customer specification handling, vendor coordination, and project-specific documentation.

Responsibilities:

* Lead control system specification handling, including concept diagrams, system architecture, communication interfaces, and integration with RTUs, HMIs, IEDs, and gateways.

* Engineer, configure, and integrate HMI, RTU, gateway, and SCADA/control systems across multiple vendors; experience with SICAM PAS, A8000, SCC, Toolbox/WinCC, COPA-DATA Zenon, Hitachi Micro SCADA, GE DS Agile, or equivalent platforms is valuable.

* Design reliable network and communication architectures, including switches, routers, GPS/time synchronization, firewalls, cyber security components, and protocol selection.

* Prepare, review, and approve FDS, system architecture, signal lists, I/O mapping, BOM, general arrangements, panel heat-load calculations, FAT/SAT procedures, test reports, and commissioning documents.

* Integrate and troubleshoot IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/103/104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC, serial/IP communication, and process bus technology where applicable.

* Support customer offers, technical clarifications, project meetings, sub-supplier supervision, risk identification, corrective actions, customer presentations, trainings, FAT/SAT, and commissioning support.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in substation automation, control systems, HMI/SCADA engineering, RTU/gateway integration, or a similar power systems automation role.
* Strong knowledge of Substation Automation systems, IEC 61850, bay/control/process levels, communication architectures, and substation control philosophy.
* Hands-on proficiency in SAS, RTU programming/configuration, HMI development, networking, database troubleshooting, I/O mapping, and IED/control system parameterization.
* Working knowledge of OS/tools, PC applications, serial/IP networking, and debugging tools such as Modscan, IEC Tester, IED Scout, Wireshark, or equivalent.
* Ability to create standardized engineering and parameterization procedures to improve quality, interoperability, performance, and repeatability.
* Strong written and spoken English communication; German language capability is an advantage where required by customer/project interface.
* Collaborative working style, strong interpersonal skills, problem-solving ability, and willingness to travel worldwide based on project requirements.
* In-depth understanding of substation parameterization and additionally configuration for IEDs and control systems
* Experience in developing and implementing standardized parameterization procedures for substation automation equipment

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent customer, supplier, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Structured critical thinking, reasoning, and analytical problem solving for complex automation and communication issues.
* Self-driven, disciplined, accountable, and able to manage quality, schedule, and cost impact within assigned scope.
* Collaborative, adaptive, and eager to learn new technologies, standards, OEM platforms, and project execution practices.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and support parallel project demands under timeline pressure.

title: Senior SDET Analyst
description:
Ready to take your career global?  
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a **Senior SDET Analyst** to join our ever evolving **Global Test Engineering** team and help shape the future of global commerce.

What you’ll own

* **End-to-End Automation & Framework Development**: Design, build, and maintain moderately complex test automation frameworks and tools, integrating them with Continuous Integration (CI) infrastructure for automated web, API, and RESTful service testing.
* **White Box & Lifecycle Testing**: Write and execute application tests at the source code level (unit, component, TDD/BDD), identifying improper coding structures and deficiencies to prevent hidden errors early in the development lifecycle.
* **Performance, Load & Security Validation**: Develop test scripts and analyze application performance, load, and security, utilizing service virtualization tools to emulate dependent system components and prevent performance bottlenecks.
* **Test Strategy & Environment Management**: Build and deploy testing environments, manage test data conditioning, and collaborate with business and development stakeholders to construct intricate test cases and ensure Payment Card Industry (PCI) compliance.
* **Project Coordination**: Act as the single point of contact for assigned client projects, coordinating test team activities, reviewing client test plans, and prioritizing execution to deliver high-quality outcomes.

What you’ll bring

* **Educational Background**: Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (equivalent experience considered).
* **Core Professional Experience**: Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in software testing, coding, designing, and automated tool development.
* **Technical Engineering Skills**: Proven proficiency in white box testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, service virtualization tools, and scripting against non-UI components like APIs and RESTful web services.
* **Analytical Problem Solving**: A seasoned, experienced professional capability with a full understanding of software testing specializations, showing a track record of resolving a wide range of structural and functional code issues.

It’s a bonus if you have

* **Extended Domain Expertise**: 6+ years of experience developing automated testing strategies across a wide variety of infrastructure environments and frameworks.
* **Think like a client**: We care deeply about our clients' success. We ask, listen and learn — curious to understand first. Our passion drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
* **Act like an owner**: We take accountability — working at pace to own our outcomes. We empower each other to make decisions. We’re innovative — always finding better ways to deliver impact.
* **Win as one team**: We value personal connections — moving forward together with clarity. We build inclusive and global teams — embracing different perspectives and ideas. It’s always ‘we,’ never ‘me.’ We’re determined to succeed together.

About the team

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

title: Associate Automation Engineer - Engineering Excellence & Experience
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
Associate Automation Engineer - Engineering Excellence& Experience
  
  
Are you looking to kickstart your career in the world of Intelligent Automation? We are seeking a motivated Associate Automation Engineer to join our Workflow Automation team within Roche Digital Technology (RDT). In this role, you will support the development and maintenance of digital processes that help Roche operate more efficiently.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers and the Product Owner, you will learn to build, test, and deploy automation solutions. The Workflow Automation team is the engine behind Roche’s digital transformation. We use modern automation tools to connect systems and simplify work for thousands of employees globally, offering a collaborative environment where junior talent is mentored by industry experts and encouraged to grow their technical skills.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
In this role, you will directly support our digital transformation efforts by building, maintaining, and refining key workflow automations. You will:
  
  

* Assist in building and configuring automated workflows and business rules, focusing on features and bug fixes to gain hands-on expertise.
* Execute unit tests and participate in quality assurance processes to ensure automated solutions are reliable, secure, and compliant with Roche standards.
* Participate actively in technical training sessions and workshops to build core stack competencies and work toward professional certifications (e.g., Pega).
* Engage in daily Agile ceremonies and stand-ups to estimate tasks, update work progress in Jira, and collaborate within a cross-functional squad.
* Maintain clear technical guides, user manuals, and process diagrams to ensure solutions are well-documented and easily maintainable.
* Support senior engineers in troubleshooting system errors and performance issues to identify root causes and implement effective fixes.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and Product Owners to turn manual process requirements into efficient, low-code automation designs.
* Contribute to driving operational efficiency across Roche by helping connect complex global systems through modern automation platforms.

Who you are
  
  
We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented early-career engineer eager to learn modern process automation tools. To succeed in this role, you bring:
  
  

* Experience: 1–3 years of experience in software engineering, IT support, or a technical internship.
* Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* Process Automation Interest: Foundational exposure or strong interest in Process Automation concepts such as BPM, RPA, or Low-Code development platforms.
* Programming& Database Basics: Solid foundational understanding of at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Java, JavaScript, Python) and SQL.
* Web& API Awareness: Familiarity with web application fundamentals, including basic understanding of REST/JSON APIs and HTML/CSS.
* Automation Tool Exposure: Broad exposure or familiarity with automation platforms (e.g., Pega, Appian, Camunda, ServiceNow, or UiPath).
* Mindset& Soft Skills: A proactive "can-do" attitude, analytical thinking to break down processes, strong Agile awareness, and excellent communication skills in a global team environment.

Call to Action
  
Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
  
  
#RDT2026
  
  
Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Key Responsibilities:**


Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to understand project requirements and define comprehensive test strategies.


Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver in Java.


Design, write, and execute detailed, comprehensive, and well\-structured manual test plans and test cases.


Perform thorough manual functional, integration, system, and regression testing.


Conduct exploratory testing to uncover defects and usability issues not covered by formal test cases.


Implement and maintain test automation frameworks (e.g., Page Object Model, TestNG/JUnit, Cucumber BDD) to ensure efficient and organized testing.


Execute automated tests, analyze results, and identify defects, working closely with development teams for resolution.


Integrate automated tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) to support agile development practices.


Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, smoke, sanity and integration testing, leveraging automation where appropriate.


Conduct API testing using tools like Postman or Swagger to validate backend services.


Perform database validation by writing and executing SQL queries to ensure data integrity.


Participate in code reviews of test automation scripts to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.


Provide clear and concise reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall product quality to stakeholders.


Continuously research and implement new testing tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the QA process.


Contribute to the improvement of overall software quality processes and practices within the team.


Required Skills \& Experience:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**8\-12 years of experience in Quality Assurance with a strong focus on test automation.**


**Proficient in designing and developing automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver.**


**Strong programming skills in at least one object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Python, C\#).**


**Experience with test automation frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, Pytest, NUnit, or similar.**


**Solid understanding and practical experience with the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern.**


**Design, write, and execute detailed, comprehensive, and well\-structured manual test plans and test cases.**


Perform thorough manual functional, integration, system, and regression testing.


Conduct exploratory testing to uncover defects and usability issues not covered by formal test cases.


Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.


Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.


Knowledge of SQL for database validation.


Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in an agile environment.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience:**


Experience with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber.


Knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).


Experience with security testing concepts and tools.


Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).


Understanding of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Relevant certifications in Quality Assurance or test automation.


Experience with mobile application test automation.


Education \& Certifications:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.


Industry certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are a plus.

**About FIS**


Are you curious, self\-motivated, and forward\-thinking? At FIS, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all fun.

 **About the Team**


This is an opportunity to join a talented team of functional and technical professionals working on digital banking solutions at one of the world’s leading providers of financial technology solutions. The team works across geographies and collaborates closely to deliver high\-quality, scalable, and reliable products for the financial services domain.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, SDET, who is passionate about quality engineering, test automation, and building robust automation solutions for web, API, batch, and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in automation testing, requirement analysis, test strategy, and Agile delivery.


In this role, you will analyse business requirements, participate in grooming and estimation, design and execute test strategies, identify automation opportunities, build and maintain automation scripts, and help improve product quality based on defect trends and testing outcomes.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Analyse business requirements and actively participate in requirement grooming and estimation.
* Work closely with product owners, developers, quality engineers, and cross\-functional teams to understand features and define effective test coverage.
* Develop test strategies, create test plans, and execute test cases for new features, enhancements, and production support scenarios.
* Identify manual test cases that are suitable for automation and develop automation scripts using Playwright, Selenium, and other automation tools.
* Build, maintain, innovate, and continuously improve automation frameworks, test processes, and quality engineering practices.
* Automate testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile channels to improve regression efficiency and product confidence.
* Perform API testing for SOAP and REST services using tools such as SOAP UI and Postman.
* Validate applications through functional, regression, accessibility, mobile, and microservices testing.
* Write, implement, maintain, and review automation scripts and test artifacts.
* Use SQL to construct moderate to complex queries for validating data and troubleshooting issues.
* Participate in Agile development methodologies and sprint ceremonies, including planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Track, analyse, and manage defects while recommending quality improvements based on defect patterns and root causes.
* Collaborate across geographies and teams to support delivery, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
**What You Bring**

* Strong hands\-on testing experience with a focus on automating web and API tests.
* Experience in UI automation testing, API testing, and automation script development and maintenance.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright and Katalon.
* Expertise in automation testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile applications.
* Experience developing or contributing to automation frameworks for enterprise applications.
* Experience on scripting languages such as Python, Ruby, Groovy, Shell, Perl, or similar.
* Strong understanding of manual testing concepts, test scenario design, test case writing, test artifact review, and defect management.
* Experience testing SOAP or REST APIs using SOAP UI, Postman, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with accessibility testing tools and practices such as JAWS and Level Access.
* Experience in mobile testing and web\-based application testing.
* Ability to write moderate to complex SQL queries for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of SDLC, defect management processes, and engineering tools such as Jira, Maven, Git, SOAP UI, Silk Central, BrowserStack, WinSCP, and Putty.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic to complex technical issues and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
